- The page is the file site/index.html (a static file opened directly; no server route).\n- <title>: word-tools\n- Exactly one <h1>, and its text contains: word-tools\n- Benefits container: data-testid=\"benefits\"\n- Each benefit: data-testid=\"benefit\" (exactly 3, all inside the benefits container), each with a short heading (h2 or h3) and one sentence in a <p>\n- Get started button: data-testid=\"get-started\", visible text exactly \"Get started\" (a <button> or an <a> styled as a button)\n- Viewport meta tag: <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n- Layout: at 375px wide the benefits are in 1 column with no sideways scrolling; at 1280px wide they are in 3 columns on one row (breakpoint min-width: 768px)\n- No external resources: no http:// or https:// URLs in src/href attributes and no remote @import\n- Existing code: src/capitalize.js and src/index.js are not touched, and the existing test src/capitalize.test.js keeps passing under npm test (node --test)
